trigger: User challenged whether the system was actually being applied globally and whether GPT personalization was masking missing control-plane behavior.

learning_decision.reason: The defect class was a direct violation of already-authoritative local invariants: OWNER_REGISTRY is membership-only, remote observations are rebuildable cache data, and unknown architecture contract versions fail closed. No new external architecture theory was needed to identify or repair this drift.

findings.detail: OWNER_ARCHITECTURE_OBSERVATIONS.json was current for Financial but stale for A-share, Novel and Video relative to their real GitHub main HEADs. Local CI can only validate the cache's internal binding, not discover newer private sibling-repository HEADs.

Video current AGENT_MANIFEST declared architecture_contract_version=1.2 while Universal AGENT_ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT supports only 1.0/1.1 and explicitly fails closed on unknown future versions. The current Video manifest introduced no new shared architecture semantics requiring a central 1.2 contract, so widening Universal compatibility would have been the wrong fix.

OWNER_REGISTRY's Novel row embedded observed_skill_version, observed_runtime_version and observed_owner_head. This duplicated rebuildable remote observation data inside the sole membership authority and had already become stale.
The existing Agent Architecture Watch was enabled but daily, allowing owner drift to remain undetected for many hours after owner changes.

repairs.action: Changed only shared architecture_contract_version from unsupported 1.2 back to centrally supported 1.1; owner-local schema_version 1.2 and runtime/business semantics were left untouched.
validate_owner_registry now rejects owner-entry fields beginning observed_ or architecture_validation_, preventing rebuildable remote observations from being embedded in OWNER_REGISTRY.
Removed stale Novel observed_* fields, declared rebuildable_remote_observations_allowed=false, and pointed remote observation data to OWNER_ARCHITECTURE_OBSERVATIONS.json.
Added current-state and adversarial regressions preventing remote observation cache fields from re-entering OWNER_REGISTRY.
Increased condition-watch cadence from daily to hourly and made unsupported owner architecture_contract_version an explicit fail-closed drift signal. No business state mutation was authorized.

instruction_surface_decision.reason: Personality is a response-style preference, not a routing or execution authority. Bare CONTINUE activation before repository bootstrap still depends on an account/product-level instruction surface or equivalent product capability; the repository cannot prove that setting is installed.

remaining_open: Novel thin-router drift and CHAT_BRIDGED assurance ceiling
Video thin-router drift and strict isolated-review assurance gap
